text:
nina: quick design check — playground structured-output & function-calling. i noticed two confusing things when testing the new schema editor: first, the 'invoke' button copy reads 'Run with tools' but the function list header says 'Definitions'. users are hesitating which to edit vs which to call. second, the run history shows raw JSON blobs for tool outputs which looks intimidating to psl users. TL;DR: copy + collapse affordance?
sam: agreed on the copy misalign. my vote: change button to 'Invoke tool(s)' and header to 'Function definitions' (explicit). shorter piece of copy under header: "Define functions your model can call".
jc: FWIW eng: we can alias the button label in the client without backend changes. we'll need a small i18n entry.
mira: accessibility nit: when you open a function definition, screen reader currently reads "close button" twice because of nested aria-labels. I'll add a quick PR to remove the redundant label. also for the run history collapse — can we show a one-line summary for tool outputs (name + status + truncated result) with an expand chevron? keyboard focus must go to the expand control.
nina: example summary idea: "Translator · success · \"Hola...\"". also thinking copy below run entry: "Output truncated. Expand to view full JSON." small and actionable.
sam: +1. Implementation thought: render the first 120 chars of the pretty-printed output and then a "Show full output" button. for non-JSON (like images) keep existing preview.
jc: we'll add a lightweight server-side sanitizer that strips overly long fine-grained keys for history (to avoid huge payloads blowing up the page). we'll log full payloads to object storage.
mira: design ask: can we surface schema validation errors inline in the editor rather than at invoke-time? small red dot next to function name that opens a tooltip listing issues. should be keyboard accessible.
nina: here's a tiny schema snippet i used that shows the problem (users thought "required" was a runtime arg):
```json
{
  "name": "translate",
  "description": "Translate text",
  "parameters": {
    "type": "object",
    "properties": {
      "text": {"type": "string"}
    },
    "required": ["text"]
  }
}
```
sam: ah — maybe label the editor tab as "Schema (parameters)" and add a short inline helper: "required = fields the function expects when called". that should reduce confusion.
mira: copy proposal for the invoke button tooltip: "Invoke tool(s) — calls any configured functions with the current prompt. Use in tool-calling mode only." short, clear.
nina: can we also add a micro-copy under the function list: "Different from prompt tools — these functions are invoked by the model via structured calls."
jc: timeline: eng can ship the button/i18n + run-history collapse in two sprints. sanitizer and object storage logging in parallel. aria fixes + inline validation tooltip are design + devex small tasks.
mira: i'll wire up an a11y checklist for the PR: aria labels, keyboard tab order for expand chevrons, focus on expand, and live region for status updates.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: playground/frontend@canary -> staging (build 1m). :rocket:
nina: sweet. thanks y'all — i'll follow up with a tiny copy doc and a Figma for the validation tooltip. :thumbsup:
